recommended_experiment.first_task: Controlled diagnosis and repair of vintage-selection failures with independently known injected cause; keep paid StockNet forecasting study fixed and separate.
recommended_experiment.task_vs_forecast: Macro vintages make selection mistakes falsifiable; they do not alone make future releases predictable or demonstrate improved financial forecasts.
recommended_experiment.episode: evidenceA eligible vintage -> declared outputB (latest publicly knowable datum at issue) -> separate exact expected truthB -> selection error -> diagnosis -> proposed one-node rule; this is an information-selection benchmark, not unknown-future market truth.
known_faults: choose latest column before cutoff instead of eligible column
collapse different revisions by period without source clock
recommended_experiment.falsification: Reject learning benefit if feedback repair fails held-out fault instances, does not improve over frozen faulty arm, or cannot match manual temporal invariants. Separate cause diagnosis accuracy from output accuracy and abstention.
controls: Hold out entire vintage transitions and fault families; do not select candidates on test transitions
Version immutable source workbook and explicit cutoff policy
Use deterministic selectors and validators before any model spend; model proposals later are new evidence
Add intact negative controls; repairing intact snapshots is an error
For semantic-model tests preserve historical pretraining contamination caveat; source gating cannot eliminate memorized future knowledge
recommended_experiment.forecast_followon: Only after mechanism test, forecast next monthly first release with loss target and sample size fixed; persistence baseline and manual rules, later revisions tracked separately; evaluate by release event, not correlated daily replicas.

proposed_adapter_contract: Implemented offline loader/selector with the explicit reconstructed cutoff policy. No online acquisition, forecast wrapper or public raw workbook bundle.

adapter_implementation.complete_runtime_suite: Parent rerun required after bounded-read fix; prior 470-test suite predates this change.
adapter_implementation.bounded_source_read: Single open stream reads at most 2097153 bytes; reject overflow before hashing. ZIP parsing uses only the admitted hash-bound byte buffer. Regression covers a grown stream and on-disk replacement after read.
